comments.author: Wen zhi
comments.body: Is it possible for a non spanish player to invest in seville in order to build better ships like vaisseau? If so, how?

comments.author: Enver
comments.body: You can't. Only way is to defect to that nation.

comments.author: Cornelia
comments.body: How can i defect to spain, so?

comments.author: Hans
comments.body:
get an aide with this skill:

Spain Correspondence

comments.author: Lisa
comments.body:
You can defect to any "weaker" nation without correspondence (but skill is needed to go to a "stronger" nation or ottoman)
Anyways, you dont need to invest a Seville for Vaisseau, you can build it in any capital (and i think Ceuta has it too). Of course, invest needed and r14 SB to see the ship.

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: OGplanet fixed the tow and logout glitch in the last patch. Now if you use tow and logout in one of the supply ports in Northern Russian waters only your base or special tow port will show up. No more 5 minute quick tows to Seville!
